# Garden State Coon
> Maine Coon cattery in Edison, New Jersey. Health-screened breeding cats from registered lines. Well-socialized kittens raised in our home and placed with families across the United States.

## Key Entities
- Cattery: Garden State Coon
- Breed: Maine Coon
- Location: Edison, NJ 08817, United States
- Nearest airport: Newark Liberty International (EWR)
- Breeding Cats: Hudson (Brown Classic Tabby sire), Willow (Blue Smoke dam), Juniper (Silver Shaded dam)

## Services
- Available kittens (rotating): Maple, Cedar, Ridge, Pebble, Harbor, Bayside
- Health-focused breeding practices; health-screened breeding cats from registered lines
- Travel: within the United States; convenient to Newark Liberty International (EWR)
- Waiting list: reservation for upcoming litters
